comment: So funny. Awesome class to take for your arts credit, even if you aren't an arts student -- helped me so much with getting over fears & gaining confidence while presenting. Very few readings, and only a couple of performances early on. Awkward at first but your class will probably be goated. Highly recommend

BEST CLASS EVER! I was hesitant at first about acting since I had no experience, but it's SO MUCH FUN. You honestly do little to no work, just pay attention to class for the quizzes which are so easy, and for the midterm and final scene, just practice your lines 15 minutes a day and it'll be the easiest A ever. Would take this class 100 times again

Very funny professor that made the class enjoyable. It's an effort based course, so you will receive an A if you put in the work to get it, and frankly not that much effort has to be exerted. There is the monologue and scene which pretty much constitute your grade, so show up to class and do well on those and its a free A for your art credit.

If you put even a moderate amount of effort into this class (including memorizing lines for the midterm and final), then this class should be an easy A. Make your presence known in class and volunteer often and she will be more lenient with your grades. Also, she hates when students are on their phones during class.
Put forth some effort, engage with the professor, and memorize your lines for your midterm and final. If you do these things, you will get an A. Go first and BE LOUD when she ask for volunteers.
Put forth some effort, engage with the professor, and memorize your lines for your midterm and final. If you do these things, you will get an A.

Ms. Cathy is literally amazing. The reading is only relevant for the quizzes, and you should always do your journals on time. Learn your lines and participate in class. Most classes ended early and we played games more than once for all of the class. Basics of Actings is a really great class to take if you want to unwind through the week.
Very nice lady but she's a very unfair grader. Your grade might drop for no apparent reason. Be careful!
Cathy is one of my favorite professors at Richmond. She truly loves all of her students and wants everyone to succeed. It is an easy A as long as you show up to class and participate.

Cathy is one of the best professors on this campus. She is extremely reasonable and expects just the right amount of effort for the class, which isn't too much to ask. She is also hilarious and has some funny stories from others who have taken her class before. It is an easy gen ed and its also quite fun. Lot's of athletes make it hilarious too.

Super easy Gen. Ed.  Definitely recommend both her and the class. Minimal effort. Mid term is a 2min monologue and final is a 7 min scene with a partner; both of which are easy once you try to put in effort.
This was a really fun and easy class, I highly recommend. She is so funny and makes the class entertaining.
